notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Smoking Barrels
notes.content:
The Zone is a breathtaking and enigmatic place. Tales of its mesmerizing vistas draw people from the Mainland, tempting them with promises of fame, fortune, groundbreaking scientific discoveries, or the allure of uncovering its deep, ancient secrets. But be warned—stepping into the Zone unprepared is a fool’s errand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/b0acc0218c486e7d655d60c6b21ba0bc8f9e3bba.jpg[/img]

While the Zone welcomes all with open arms, its inhabitants do not. Though the landscape may be beautiful, danger lurks behind every corner and along every path. You may think the monstrous creatures that prowl its shadows are the greatest threat, and in some ways, you'd be right. But rest assured, in this place, you're more likely to be riddled with bullets than scratched by claws. That’s why mastering the art of handling a weapon is not just a skill—it’s a lifeline. And oh, the Zone has a staggering variety of them.

[b]Where to Find a Gun[/b]

Here, gunfire has been a constant symphony for years. Almost everyone carries a weapon, often two or even three, prepared for whatever horrors the day may bring. You can haul as many firearms as your back can bear, but remember, you only have two hands and a couple of shoulders to wield them at a moment’s notice. And don’t forget your pistol — that faithful sidearm you reach for when all else fails or when you’re conserving precious primary ammunition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/2e501ae0e8a0098619218d4b35a5c940647c4354.gif[/img]

If you find yourself without a weapon, don’t panic — look around. The Zone is an A-Life system, and luck may be on your side. Perhaps you'll hear the echo of a nearby firefight or stumble upon the aftermath of one. Where there's been shooting, there are those who no longer need their weapons. And with a little luck, you might find a gun along with some attachments, ready to be mounted and tailored to the fight ahead.

[b]Clean, Shoot, Upgrade, Repeat[/b]

Don’t expect any weapon you find to be in pristine condition. While you might occasionally stumble upon one in decent shape, especially in hidden stashes left behind by cautious stalkers, weapons often require maintenance. Regular visits to a technician to service your gear are essential. You’ll know the state of your weapon by checking your inventory, but you’ll surely notice when your gun starts faltering at the worst possible moment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/0e8610c72fb557274700526c6d226c750bdc873e.gif[/img]

With enough experience, you’ll come to appreciate the quirks of your chosen weapon — how it’s saved your life in tight spots and the adjustments you wish it had to send those "complimentary olives" more effectively. When you’ve saved enough currency, don’t hesitate to visit a technician again. They can enhance your gear—not just weapons but your whole kit—tailoring it to your combat style. Whether you need a specialized tool for a particular type of mission or a flexible weapon for all-around use, they’ve got you covered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/4290f1c9ac80d593e8736fa107be4d97e9fccbef.gif[/img]

[b]Bullets, "Maslynas", and More Bullets [/b]

Yes, to shoot, you need bullets. The more, the merrier—just don’t forget that ammo has weight. You can carry as much as you find or buy, but remember: an overloaded stalker is a slow, vulnerable target. Understanding your surroundings and what you might encounter is as valuable a skill as marksmanship itself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/0a94c61f0c431ee4a094d1e851ce3cfb44bb3842.gif[/img]

Before heading out, think strategically. Where are you going? What or whom might you encounter? Stock up on the right type of ammunition accordingly. Standard rounds might do in a pinch, but for tougher foes, consider armor-piercing or hollow-point rounds. Each type can make all the difference, depending on your weapon and the caliber it fires. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/27413ee78e676bec143ae02be4278448aa4588bc.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/ffd298cc2f7d1c16dfb38826f1502e882e7e1f25.jpg[/img]

Every gun feels unique, firing differently based on its build and range. Effectiveness varies according to distance and the protection your target wears. Don't expect to snipe accurately with a shotgun, and good luck maneuvering a sniper rifle in close combat — unless you’ve taken the time to modify it with on-the-go upgrades.

[b]Expect the Unexpected[/b]

Preparation is your shield in the Zone. Don't expect a leisurely walk through the park; this is a land of ever-shifting perils. But with enough skill, knowledge of the terrain, a clear understanding of your objectives, and the right supplies, survival is within reach. Never forget: the Zone has a twisted sense of humor. The more intimately you know Her and prepare for the unexpected, the better your chances of seeing another sunrise. Explore Her mysteries, adapt to Her challenges, and keep your eyes on the prize you’ve set for yourself.

notes.title: Characters: Richter
notes.content:
The Zone has been around for nearly two decades, and an entire generation has grown up hearing stories of its treasures and dangers.  Some have vowed never to even think about stepping foot in here, while others dreamt of delving at the very first chance. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/8b7f6260614f98b1289b29b8648bd1e64a894b2c.jpg[/img]

Real family and home are not granted. Richter knows this very well. Just after escaping the foster house, he rushed straight into the Zone, becoming one of the youngest stalkers. Roaming and exploring all over the “safe” parts for years, he earned a place here as a guide and became a guy who is welcome in most bars and camps. Alas, be it an overexaggerated optimism or just levity, one of the runs ended with only Richter surviving to reach the destination. That was the end of his overconfident “feeling the Zone” days, as well as the guiding career — but not the end of his true love for the Zone that keeps him rolling even now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/5dae2434dc66fa032a508b1ec9eb8716f255422a.jpg[/img]

When his homeland teetered on the edge of losing its freedom, Richter pretty rapidly found himself among close-minded stalkers who are not so good with Varta conditions. Spark of resistance is smoldering, and it might be on him to fan the flames and give it the air it needs to burn brightly.

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Tour the Zone
notes.content:
The Zone is what you consider it to be. Second Catastrophe may have changed its’  landscape, ecosystem, and all the other aspects that have no definitions yet. But still, there are places the same as before the first anomaly appeared… By a first non-careful glance, though. 

[h2]ZATON[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/6e2be5584093592e9c9f2b7ce12643fcf1648a03.jpg[/img]
Photo by: Project Chornobyl Zone - Radioactive Team

For a hundred years before the Zone was born, Chornobyl was one of the key ports on the Prypiat River. Its convenient channel and calm flow enhanced the town’s trade and crafts. The shipbuilding traditions stood the test of time. In the XXth century, “Chornobyl Repair&Maintenance River Fleet Base” was operating near Nuclear Power Plant, with its natural backwater serving as a harboring port.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/6a71b9a5b2ad487632597ec90dfa4922d3e63ec2.png[/img]

After the 2nd Catastrophe, the area known as ”Zaton” began to slowly drain, turning into a swampy wasteland full of abandoned, rusty, radioactive barges and ships.  From the very beginning of the stalkers’ arrival, this place was at the epicenter of conflict between neutrals and bandits. In which the latter eventually won. Since then, the stalkers’ dry cargo base, formerly known as “Skadovsk”, changed the name to “Sultansk” by the resident leader's personal order. 

[h2]DUGA[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/33716543857e62a7e1a94c7729a818553cbcc2a9.jpg[/img]
Photo: from GSC Game World team archive

A spawn of the Cold War, the over-the-horizon radar Duga, is a top-secret military project whose cost was even higher than the one of CNPP construction. Designed to detect air strikes early, this titanic antenna complex is approximately 150 meters high and is almost always visible in the western region of the Zone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/fc73d272776b974ecced79141747aa3ac803be6f.png[/img]

Since the Exclusion Zone turned into the Anomalous Zone, Duga became one of the highest priority objects for the Military and IPSF. Unlike its near-Prypiat  “sister”, called Rainbow, also known as the Brain Scorcher, Duga remained under the control of official forces for years and was practically unreachable. 

[h2]RED FORTRESS[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/c66ab8b0a44dfc187941335a5e7c1081b0e549e1.jpg[/img]
Photo by: Ihor Khomych

Near the Cooling Towers placed the reason for their creation — the half-build 5th and 6th Reactor Core blocks. Originally planned to launch in 1987, this now rusted and hollow monument mirrors the design of the destroyed block. However, it was never equipped with electronics, furniture, or finished interior surfaces. Even before the 2nd Catastrophe, this place was dangerous to explore: jagged rebar, yawning gaps, and annoying Geiger counter clicks could hurt, or even worse. Surrounded by support workshops and a radioactive waste disposal site, this complex resembles a vast, grim industrial fortress. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/9da9ee7c72d79fbb8018b42c1a2bb466fa7fc1c0.png[/img]

When the voice of the Monolith was gone and stalkers cautiously began to chart the surroundings of the Nuclear Station, they discovered the Red Fortress. All the evidence inside, and information from the rare interrogations of ex-fanatics were pointing that their major base was here. Perhaps, even the main one. 

[h2]PRYPIAT[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/2b60c61e6c20f9b3b553f478e4fd4db0ec964fce.jpg[/img]
Photo by: Ihor Khomych

“Atomic city” construction on the banks of Prypiat started simultaneously with CNPP. In April 1986, its life froze, and “Atomic city” turned into the most infamous ghost town. Mirror-like neighborhoods and abandoned flats are forever stuck into the memories of those who met the most terrifying man-made disaster just a few kilometers from its epicenter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/cfcaa9bebeb8a4e71d4f32fb8bdd2cc2c8abf591.png[/img]

The first expeditions sent by Duty and Freedom entered Prypiat immediately after Brain Scorcher had been deactivated. They were shortly followed by neutrals pursuing untouched anomalies and hidden Monolith stashes. Once the quietest place in the Zone turned into the battlefield… Until it gained its own defenders who protect Prypiat from outsiders and shield the outside world from what this city hides.

notes.title: Professor Hermann
notes.content:
Once, the "PhD practice at Yantar" was a notorious and effective method for quashing the scientific ambitions of the most freethinking and bothersome students. Many of them changed careers after the experience, some went on extended sick leave, and a few… never returned. Of course, there were exceptions, and Hermann was one of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/76dd99187e4236c823bc25fab88d86ccafe6f7cd.jpg[/img]

Shortly after the Brain Scorcher was deactivated, Hermann became the chief scientist of one of the first expeditions into the Zone's heartlands. As a professor, he managed a mobile lab near the Jupiter Plant, gaining the opportunity to study the Zone more deeply than hundreds of his cozy, mainland-based colleagues. While he may not have been the bravest, his thirst for recognition and his knack for finding people to carry out the most dangerous tasks sustained him through years of successful work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/e27f83dff3297be16b37dc8b7df166e0ba67618c.jpg[/img]

When SIRCAA was established, he earned the well-deserved position of senior researcher. However, over the years, his theories about the possibility of generating artifacts outside the Zone led him to conduct private experiments. Completely in secret from his colleagues, and, most importantly, from management.

Stalker 2 is a game that's walking a tightrope with realism, trying to make sure that it's fun while at the same time fine-tuning the rhythm of its gameplay.

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — “Scar” Trailer
notes.content:
Once a mercenary. Then — a man who turned the tides of Faction Wars and witnessed the Clear Sky. One of the Legends, and now — a leader, guiding stalkers against the oppression of CIRCAA and the Wards. 

[previewyoutube=b9xT_kNnlsk;full][/previewyoutube]

Will you help the Spark light the path out of the Dark Side?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/289053286076afee9746ab0d7eae0ffef5594478.png[/img]

The southeastern border of the Zone is a forsaken land of bogs and vapors, where time itself seems to have halted. Now, the Swamps teem with mutants in a realm of delusion, where the line between reality and nightmare blurs. Rare expeditions venture into this desolate place, and only a few have returned to tell tales of a distant hamlet beyond unfordable psi-fields. And they vow never to go back.

On August 22, 2008, Stalkers witnessed the journey of a mercenary who awoke from an Emission at the Clear Sky base, hidden amidst a raging faction war and renegades infesting the Swamps, on its far edge. Scar became one of the Legends, but the culmination of his path seems to be only just beginning!

notes.content:
[previewyoutube=CNwLYx28aiA;full][/previewyoutube]

Three hours of cinematic cutscenes await you in S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl. By living your story in the Zone, you won’t see them all in one playthrough. But maybe within the second one or even the third… Who knows. That will depend solely on your decisions.

Take an inside look at how we are creating this cinematic experience by combining motion-capture technologies, professional actors, and narrative. Small hint: in this video, you can notice one cutscene that plays differently. Which one you’ll experience in the game is entirely your choice.

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.2: Heart of Chornobyl — World & Locations
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Z5TmiZUOosE;full][/previewyoutube]

The Zone in S.T.A.L.K.E.R.2: Heart of Chornobyl is a seamless open world, a place where every corner hides a story, waiting to be uncovered. It would be a tough challenge to learn all Her secrets in one playthrough. 

You can start your exploration by setting the goal of visiting all the different locations. From muddy Swamps to sinister streets of Prypiat, each region has its own unique vibes. Different inhabitants, different architecture and nature — we can’t wait to know which region will be your favorite.

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Dive into the Zone
notes.content:
What is the Zone? Many will say it is an area near the Chornobyl Nuclear Plant, infested with anomalous manifestations and full of armed thugs. But those who have ever felt the breeze of the river Prypiat will say: it is about freedom.

In creating S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl, the main goal is to provide players with this feeling of freedom. With the understanding that the only barrier that stands between you and your destination is the danger, and it’s only up to you to overcome it. 

[h1]Land[/h1]

During its decades of existence, the Zone’s ecosystem has formed in phenomenal and malformed ways. Once a plain forest-steppe, the land changed dramatically after the Second Catastrophe, diversifying in landscape and regions — each resonating with its own echoes of past and present. 

[i][u]“S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 is a huge, seamless open world, consisting of twenty regions, and each region has its own residents, architecture, anomalies and even nature, and many of them could well be a fully separate game”[/u][/i] — [b]Dzmitry Anoshka, Level Art Team Lead[/b]

Starting with the pastoral countryside full of abandoned villages, that once were hosting generations of memories… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/3858d3d04ac3ca6089523c35753dc85867f71e5f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/e0f9df0f5147934960310cb2133bdab1b90fca74.gif[/img]
[i]Chornobyl village and the city of Prypiat are only a few of the settlements that were forsaken after the Catastrophe. Now, these remains are a shelter for scavengers, mutants, and hell knows what else. [/i]

…Through anomaly-warped nature and industrial mazes, saturated with hazardous beauty… 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/d07af66ee6743c5efcea20ef557879953f1016d6.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/04adaa50ab7c896f685455428c104f0c93dd5d02.gif[/img]
[i]Here, a path from point A to point B is never a cakewalk — even without foes in sight. Anomalous fields and Archanomalies are the final stop for countless voyagers. [/i]

…Beneath the ground, in the darkest places where the most sinister secrets and dangers lurk…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/abd669cb913b8b539c1e87e7dd3409b22fd1566c.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/8c2f2b80d27cc46a6dca4768969cbd0c7ef17ee9.gif[/img]
[i](Un)natural caves, catacombs, and notorious X-labs are spread throughout the Zone, attracting diggers and the most daring ones in search of treasures and priceless intel.[/i]

…To desolate industrial and urban jungles, hosting shadows of the grim past of these lands. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/04da28adb2d5cf9aa5fb6b0ad99779fdf551fe69.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/08ceb0cddc5af9f53a5396a7a4f5147f482f38d2.gif[/img]
[i]The ghost city of Prypiat is perhaps the most infamous of all the Zone’s sightseeing places. In the perilous desolation of these lands, the city can break down even the seasoned stalkers. [/i]

We have a chance to create the Zone in such a way only because it’s a place you can visit in the real world.  With only an hour’s ride from Kyiv, its impact on history and people's lives is hard to underestimate. While transferring this place to an alternate digital incarnation, a vast number of genuine references became crucial. From indigenous plants to peeling paint on the walls — via the photogrammetry method, some elements of the Zone come right from her real counterpart. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/132ad07124f4cf84002209bcef2eb8e047f1d273.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/e18d04d22248e475aaeac4ec39f04f560cf15f09.png[/img]
[i]The river Prypiat was conquered and ripped. Its flow is stripped into artificial ponds to be gathered and cooled to feed the cores. So-called Gradyrni, or Cooling Towers, were almost built to ensure constant work of the new 5th and 6th ChNPP reactors… Now it will never be finished. Photo by: Project Chornobyl Zone - Radioactive Team[/i]

Those who have experience roaming the Zone may find some nostalgic moments in visiting familiar places. Over the years, some of them stayed frozen in time like many things here, while others have completely changed in different ways. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/71ecb34182ffd1cd8e6480e4e49acde6258290de.gif[/img]
[i]The Brainscorcher, once an irresistible barrier before the heartlands of the Zone, now stands as a grim reminder of the most turbulent times. [/i]

[h1]Locals[/h1]

At the very dawn of this land, there were only pioneer explorers searching for artifacts, and military guards trying to stop them. However, as word spread about the land's treasures and lawlessness, it became increasingly crowded.

As for the moment of your upcoming arrival, the Zone will be filled with individuals who may either help or obstruct your goals. In some cases, no chance for negotiations will be provided — but sometimes, the role you play in some other stalker’s life journeys will be entirely up to you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/0708d2bfb3f980ec5a4ef7b88fb28c1b294aa227.png[/img]
[i]Loners, or neutral stalkers, is a general term for any non-affiliated trespassers. Whether it’s a struggle for riches, a way of downshifting, or the search for new meanings — hundreds of newcomers find a reason to come and stay in the Zone. [/i]

As more people and weapons filled these lands, the need to organize into groups and address diverse issues grew. Over the decades, local factions emerged, representing a formed, though always volatile, political system — each with its own ideology, lifestyle, and gear preferences. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/945c212070900030fc8cfa86a7f7cdf4ae5e24f2.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/90c421e0fe593f3d700c6bddb58907edb20069d0.gif[/img]
[i]While neutrals keep their nomadic habits even while camping in their Zalissya and Kordon hubs, Freedomers prefer to live high and bright. And their newly-acquired Rostok base is helping a lot! [/i]

[i][u]“Depending on your choices, you’ll get a little different story, little different quests. encounter something new. If you walk through again, you will find yourself on the other side of the barricade, so to say, and look at it in a different way.”[/u][/i] — [b]Mariia Grygorovych, Creative Director[/b]

You here — a stalker. With your own unique reason to come here, perhaps, but you're one among many others like you. Be it thugs, explorers, scavengers, mercs, or paramilitaries…  The Zone is merciless to all equally. 

[h1]The Hazard[/h1]

What are the dangers here? Well, let’s try to count: radiation, anomalies of all kinds, a dozen and a half mutant species, trigger-happy lowlifes and skilled killers… Don’t mind devastating Emissions and Psy-stuff that will turn you into an aggressive husk in case of exposure without proper gear or specialized meds. 

[i][u]“Don’t forget to keep an eye on Skif’s condition. He may be hungry, he may want to sleep like a real person. Every such issue reduces his efficiency, so you always should keep an eye out.”[/u][/i] - [b]Ingvar Dovgoteles, Cinematic Team Lead[/b]

Besides that, keep in mind that you are only a human. Any foray into the unknown besides mental preparation requires decent supply management. Otherwise, you are risking not even getting to the destination. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/d4311427dc904e9f430f1fe7156f4f44fb8c9d76.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/7088943371757edbb8eb5c9de2b59abaa06d5434.png[/img]
[i]Stalker’s field ration is scarce, but crucial. Grab some snacks and don’t ignore meds when it really hurts. [/i]

Some specific issues may require additional doping. While vodka remains a universal rad-cleaner and presumably inner sanitizer, more sophisticated substances like Hercules or Vinca can pull you out at the right moment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/d8e3e4714a1ab9a897e545231fd26de5bab9fbc7.gif[/img]
[i]PsyBlocker, for example, provides your neurons a chance not to be deep-fried in rendezvous with a controller or near intense ψ-radiation source. [/i]

[u][i]“One of the core drivers of the player’s progression and power is searching the area and finding new equipment, weapons, weapon attachments, upgrades. Most of these items can be achieved not through the storyline, but through player’s curiosity from exploration of the world.”[/i][/u] — [b]Ievgen Grygorovych, Game Director[/b]

Besides improvements in skill and gumption, the path requires more equipment as you dwell deeper. Protective armor, respirator, detector, and most of all, weapons — the stuff that will help you to even the odds against the growing resistance of the Zone. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/c975c29fd536ffc97e6c8c3534156c8944224aa6.gif[/img]
[i]The more gear and supplies you carry into the foray — the less you’ll be able to scavenge and carry out. A pack has volume limits, and your back is not made of steel! [/i]

Another side of the try-to-survive dice is a fine-tuning of your tools. Some models may seem fine, but sometimes pushing to the limit is a key. Local tinkerers would love to help you, for the right price.   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/48f9fc2ee725a682c850e7af4d91c48ffb333431.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/42477880f45d8cca8bb2abdb0e2d59b0cb05829e.gif[/img]
[i]Along with direct upgrades, keep an eye out for different attachments and try them out on the go. [/i]

On top of that, it’s better not to neglect the treasures that the Zone provides. These things tarnish and become nearly useless on the Mainland, but inside the Perimeter… Artifacts are able to alter the mere physiology of a human being and with a smart approach, make a stalker as tenacious as some of the local mutants. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/d8daaad3a2eea341b7dba7eac8c6fe80a9e12103.png[/img]
[i]Diverse, mysterious, and sometimes extremely precious. Artifacts made the Zone so populated at the time, and what keeps the economy running to this day.[/i]

To complete the path, decisions have to be made. Your choices will shape the journey and define who will stand by your side, and who’s worth a bullet. It’s about the freedom to decide: where to go and for what, how not to become another one lost to the Zone, and why you are really here… But it’s better to see once than overhear a dozen times! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/bdd2b5e31f2eef385874ca039c3a96800f2e8750.gif[/img]

[h2]Stay tuned for more insights and intel about the miracles and dangers of the Zone.[/h2]

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — Final Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Dear stalkers,

Last year, during Gamescom 2023, we finally had the chance to meet in person. We gathered around the campfire with you to share something valuable that we have been creating for you for all these years — a small part of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl. Publicly, for the first time ever. 

Our one-time initiative then transformed into a journey from campfire to campfire across France, Brazil, Singapore and other countries. Thousands of players were able to play the game themselves and give us the much-needed feedback afterwards. 

And as true friends always do, you shared your honest thoughts about the game. Both positive and negative, and we are thankful for that. From your insights, we figured out two key points: the one to celebrate and the one to consider seriously. 

The first one: the Zone remains the Zone. In its true beauty and after our likeness. The game absolutely feels and plays like S.T.A.L.K.E.R, the atmosphere, hardcore style, harsh and unwelcoming environment are ready to cook, and we can’t be more grateful for these words, as they basically sum up both the key intention and the main inspiration for the project from the very beginning at the same time. 

The second one was: the gear in the backpack should be checked one more time to be completely sure it will not fail us in the most needed moment. On the technical side of things — the game needs more time.

Throughout the frankly challenging development process, we understood the time was of the team's main essence. Seeing the scope of polishing and understanding that we can’t push your patience too much, we were absolutely dedicated to releasing the game in Q1 2024, and we worked extra hard to meet the release window.

That, however, doesn’t change the fact that at the beginning of this year, we still witnessed the certain amount of technical imperfections that hold S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 below the expected standards for the final experience our fans are waiting for. 

While there is absolutely no way to make another delay sound less dim, we decided to be clear about our reasons to postpone the game for the sake of yet another wave of polishing.

The final release date for S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl is now September 5, 2024.

[previewyoutube=6o6D_a3PAHw;full][/previewyoutube]

We know that you are waiting for this moment, as well as we do. But the preparation needs to be done so that the journey into the Zone goes smoothly and as planned. Thanks for your patience and continuous support, and be ready to see a lot of info about the game further this year.

notes.title: Merry Christmas and Happy New Year
notes.content:
The snowstorm outside the window was gettign worse, but inside, near crackling campfire surrounded with supplies, it was cozy. Each stalker contributed to the occasion. On Christmas Eve, it is crucial to be with those with whom you’ve stood side by side the whole year, with people you trust and want to share the moment. 

The stalker cheered with their smoked by the fire mugs, wished each other Merry Christmas, shared freshly cooked dishes and dived into heartfelt conversations about home, friends, and the adventures awaiting on the road. Christmas is an opportunity to unite in the face of all the obstacles and realize that you are not alone. It’s a time to reminisce about  childhood, snowball fights, sometimes not exactly fair, but where you didn’t care until the moment mother saw you covered in snow. It’s a moment to tslk about family you haven’t seen for a very long time and truly miss. It’s a chance to believe that you will definitely gather around the peaceful family fireside once your long foray is over. 

This Christmas, stalkers send greetings to all of us, wishing strength and the will to navigate through all the challenges, to be strong and courageous. They advise us to support each other and find our own way to the Heart of Chornobyl. If they could do it, we can do it too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/c55604e4e99983296784499a7476c3ddb6c5e625.jpg[/img]

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year, friends. Thank you for staying with us despite the snowstorms.

notes.title: Stalker 2 is seriously tough, like Fallout meets Dark Souls
notes.content:
Stalker 2 is killing me. I'm aware of the cliche, or the kind of running joke, that game reporters are no good at videogames. I also know that if I start outlining my gaming accomplishments, in an attempt to prove that I'm quite good at games actually, it's just going to sound feeble and silly. But I'm 33 years old, I've been playing games since I was four, and I have completed Dark Souls, and let me tell you, Stalker 2 makes me scared. It's asking me to completely rethink how I approach FPS games, to forget concepts like power and bravado, and adapt to a much more difficult, but also much deeper, shooter experience. It looks like Fallout 4, but one wrong move - and I do mean one wrong move - and you're just another body, lost to the Zone.

notes.title: Stalker 2 is getting a multiplayer mode in a free post-launch update
notes.content:
GSC Game World has revealed that its ambitious, open-world first-person shooter Stalker 2 will be getting multiplayer like the original game. This Stalker 2 multiplayer mode, which will be free, won't be available at launch though.

The multiplayer mode was mentioned in a now-deleted Twitter post where GSC Game World detailed its future plans for Stalker non-fungible tokens (NFTs) after announcing its first ones yesterday to much criticism. Under the studio's plans, players would have the chance to become the "first-ever metahuman" - a non-player character - or own multiple in-game items.

However, tucked away within the statement, was the confirmation of Stalker 2 multiplayer, which will include gloves and tattoos for players to equip, as well as skins and badges - the latter of which we assume is like an emblem in Call of Duty. The multiplayer will also have both deathmatch and team deathmatch modes (as revealed in PCGamer's latest magazine issue). These items will be available to unlock through multiplayer progression - something we expect to hear more about as we gear up to launch in April 2022.

One more push ahead, and even the safe and cozy Yaniv can already be seen. Some starving howls are following along, closer and louder every second. The backpack is full of precious habar from a foray, though no breath to keep it further. Whoever was there knows… In moments like this, you should start to say goodbyes to the habar or your life, depending on one’s values. 

For that kind of mishap, experienced stalkers got an ace in the can, the same as 16 years ago. Reliable. Tasty. And refreshing, how it should be. Be NON STOP by nature, but keep a few in your stash.

notes.title: Hey buddy, Merry Christmas!
notes.content:
Buddy, if you are reading this, means Barkeep kept the word and delivered my letter. That's been a while time no see. Still got the flash of our last battle when we, all together with even monolith guys, had a stand against those scumbags in Red Forest. You said "we'll meet soon", and I sincerely believe that will be so. We'll sit near some campfire and talk about all that happened. 

Happened a lot. To me, at least. I thought that last year was tough, with all that virus threat… And now I just want to lay down somewhere warm, under dim flashlight and not hear those damn sirens that howl across the Zone, day by day. 

But that's alright, it will pass. There were so many things. I even had to leave the Perimeter to secure my family away. That's we who get used to canned food, no heat-no light, but I want something else for them. Now in the new place, trying to enjoy their lives and believe in the best. That's quite a self-aid indeed! I can finally take a breath now when they are safe. 

Remember that red-haired lad with bouffant mustaches? The one from my group, whose you were drunk-fighting with guitars near Yanov. He's gone. 2 days after we separated during the Zone defense. Have been clenching his Freedom badge till the end. 

I hope so much that you are safe and sound. That your loved ones, friends, all of them are alive, and your brother is alright. They say that he joined up the military. And although we got some rumbles with them at the Zone, now we know he is doing important things. So I wish him luck and success. And come back alive. Without him, his bottle brothers and sister, we wouldn't be interested in the mysteries and fate of the Zone and C-Consciousness. 

Well, in recent times, it's not the adventures we have been asking for. That's why there is less data about the Zone, forays and habar. But I'm sure next year will be plenty of positives — out of the victory, reuniting with family and friends, out of the simple silence. 

Cutting the stuff, I will be really glad to meet you. So much awaits us! Wish you to take a rest and be solid. Be sure of yourself and all of us!

Happy holidays, friend!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40721482/5a73d1624f32ab6f25e758c1efc4325b78134b65.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Music of the Storm
notes.content:
The thunder rolls and echoes in the head. It breaks through the samey and gray atmosphere of the Zone. Monotonous, constantly repeating, the rumble does not allow unwinding. It rolls once more, and more, and more.

But it doesn't distress and crush you or dispirit either. On the contrary, now you look onwards, carefully choose where you can step, where you can go. You are ready, at any moment you can repulse anyone you meet. Is it still the thunder, or the heartbeat that devoured all other sounds? What’s the difference? There is only one possible outcome, this soundtrack will also devour you. 

Concentrate. Watch your back and go for your goal. Storming is here.

notes.content: Федеральная служба безопасности Российской Федерации (ФСБ) решила не возбуждать уголовное дело о госизмене в отношении гражданина России, который перевел средства украинскому благотворительному фонду "Вернись живым" (Come Back Alive). Об этом говорится в заявлении московского отделения ведомства, передает "КоммерсантЪ".

notes.title: В Steam обновилась страница S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 — теперь там говорится, что игра выйдет в декабре 2023 года
notes.content: В Steam обновилась страница шутера S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 от украинской студии GSC Game World. В графе с датой релиза теперь указано, что проект ожидается в декабре 2023 года.

notes.title: Stalker 2 developers continue work as key team members fight for Ukraine
notes.content: Development on Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl was recently delayed until 2023. Its developer GSC Game World was based in Kyiv but, since Russia's invasion of Ukraine, has been facing the direst of circumstances. It had to temporarily pause development while it helped some employees flee the conflict, and evacuate its old office, while other employees are volunteering or have signed up for the Ukrainian armed forces... Read more.

notes.title: Создатели S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 показали интро шутера и устроили провокацию на презентации Xbox
notes.content: В рамках презентации Xbox Games Showcase Extended украинская студия GSC Game World опубликовала интро из шутера S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2. Релиз игры состоится в 2023 году на PC и Xbox Series X|S.

notes.title: Stalker 2 opening shared alongside devs' poignant Ukraine war diary
notes.content:
GSC Game World has shared the opening sequence of Stalker 2 at the Xbox and Bethesda Games Showcase after showing a video diary detailing how the war in Ukraine has affected the developers' lives and their work on the game.

The initial video tracks the days and months of the war which broke out on February 24, 2022, and focuses on a number of developers from across GSC Game World who were based in Ukraine's capital city Kyiv. Some joined the Ukrainian forces, others have been displaced from their homes and are hiding out in shelters or houses, and some are still working on the game. GSC also explains that many of its developers' stories couldn't be shared in the video due to concerns over their safety.

It is a brutal but necessary look at how the war has affected developers like GSC Game World, with indie game Replaced, developed by a studio in Belarus, also being delayed to 2023 due to the war.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Stalker 2 has been delayed until the end of 2022
Stalker 2 is getting a multiplayer mode in a free post-launch update
Stalker 2 will be one of the first Unreal Engine 5 games for Xbox Series X|S

notes.title: Behold the path to the Heart of Chornobyl itself!
notes.content:
There are some events that change your life entirely. Your desires, expectations, the pace of life and mindset, and even what’s waking you up in the morning. Splits the life into “before” and “after”. 

It's been 111 days since an event like this happened to every Ukrainian. The war that is still here.

Some people are forced to leave their homeland. Others have devoted themselves to volunteering or defending the country with arms. GSC Game World is a Ukrainian company, so our story is alike. Everyone is in their place and helps Ukraine to win. And at the same time, we are working hard on S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl, which development became even more momentous and symbolic. 

[previewyoutube=RxcfxdG22pg;full]https://youtu.be/RxcfxdG22pg[/previewyoutube]

The Zone reveals a whole new world! We can stick with the old one, fearing change… but tell me, do you want our descendants to remember us as cowards? Or those who dared to venture forward to a new, better humanity? 

Despite the threats that veil the journey from the ordinary world we used to call “homе” to the unknown. Would we dare to pursue the comprehension of human nature that shapes under the prism of a new reality?

However, we are already on this path. The path to the Heart of Chornobyl itself!

[previewyoutube=4PqR5OBb1Ys;full]https://youtu.be/4PqR5OBb1Ys[/previewyoutube]

Helping Ukraine is a good deed that everyone can be a part of. We are sincerely grateful to those who have already contributed and encourage those who have the ability to help Ukraine through the fundraising platform launched by the President of Ukraine initiative: [url=https://u24.gov.ua]u24.gov.ua [/url]

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 выйдет без русской озвучки — остались только субтитры
notes.content: Шутер S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 будет представлен только с украинской и английской звуковыми дорожками — разработчики из GSC Game World отказались от русского дубляжа.

notes.title: Stalker 2 delayed until 2023
notes.content: Development on Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl recently resumed, after being paused in February following the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Studio GSC Game World was based in Kyiv but has had to help its staff and their families relocate, during which period it also changed the game's name: hit's now Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl, reflecting the Ukrainian spelling of the region... Read more.

notes.title: "Это баг Steam": GSC Game World подтвердила, что не планирует продавать S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 в России
notes.content: Сегодня ночью в российский сегмент Steam внезапно вернулись многие игры издателей, ранее приостановивших продажи в регионе. Некоторые проекты при этом не отображались через поиск по магазину, а часть просто не добавлялись в корзину, либо были по-прежнему недоступны.

notes.title: Work on Stalker 2 is once again underway
notes.content: The community manager for GSC game world has said that development on Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl has resumed. In a post on Discord, GSC Game World community representative Mol1t has said that "it continues" and "the work is in progress.".. Read more.

notes.title: "Работаем!": Создатели S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 ответили на вопрос о статусе проекта
notes.content: Происходящее на территории Украины затронуло в том числе и игровую индустрию, особенно, местный геймдев.

notes.title: Stalker 2 site banned by Russian authorities in petty censorship
notes.content: Russia's ongoing invasion of Ukraine has had an enormous impact on studios and independent developers anywhere near the conflict. Stalker 2 developer GSC Game World was based in the Ukrainian capital city Kyiv, but is currently in the process of relocating to Prague, and in March ceased all operations in Russia... Read more.

notes.title: Распространял запрещенную информацию: Роскомнадзор объяснил блокировку сайта S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 в России
notes.content: В пятницу, 22 апреля, Роскомнадзор ограничил на территории России доступ к сайту игры S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl от украинской студии GSC Game World. В ведомстве объяснили блокировку.

notes.title: Роскомнадзор заблокировал сайт S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 за экстремизм
notes.content: Представители Роскомнадзора приняли решение заблокировать на территории России доступ к официальному сайту игры S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2. Об этом сообщает РБК.

notes.title: "Кто-то выбился из своего стойла": В сети появились возможные спойлеры S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 — будьте осторожны
notes.content: По сети начали активно распространяться возможные спойлеры игры S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 от украинской студии GSC Game World. Их у себя на странице "ВКонтакте" опубликовал автор популярного YouTube-канала "Неважно, Кто" Ахмет Габдрахманов, решивший таким образом выразить протест против разработчиков. Сам он назвал это "подарочком".

notes.title: Together we raised 800 000$!
notes.content:
The charity sale of GSC Game World games is over.

The great reason to be proud of our community. Thank you all! Those who hear Ukrainians. Those who open their doors to Ukrainians. Those who do not stand aside: tweet, show their support, correspond, offer help, take to the streets all around the world, donate money, participate in charity sales, join the ranks of volunteers, feed those who are starving, dismantle blockages, protect, treat, transport, rescue and never back down.

You are incredible!

Together with you, we’ve managed to raise more than $800,000. After taxes and store commissions, all funds will be donated to the «Come Back Alive» Charitable Foundation. Thanks to this sale, there are more Cossacks in the Sich, stalkers in the Zone, and the Ukrainian people made new friends ready to come to his aid.

We will remember that. Always.

notes.title: Разработчикам S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 предложили заменить русский язык на польский
notes.content: На сайте Change.org появилась петиция с предложением заменить в игре S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 русский язык на польский. Авторы считают, что студия GSC Game World должна пойти на такое решение в связи с последними событиями вокруг России и Украины и активным участием Польши в помощи украинским беженцам. На момент написания данной заметки обращение собрало более 4 тысяч подписей. Официальной реакции пока не последовало.

notes.title: Кордон, Дуга и Припять: GSC Game World рассказала о "сотнях знакомых и новых локаций" в S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2
notes.content: Фанаты "Сталкера" продолжают интересоваться подробностями и деталями сиквела, заваливая разработчиков различными вопросами в Discord-канале франшизы.

notes.title: GSC Game World Charity Sale is still ON!
notes.content:
Friends! We are incredibly grateful for every purchase during the GSC for Ukraine Charity Sale. Now we see your powerful support — on some platforms we even had to generate new game keys for the S.T.A.L.K.E.R series.

By purchasing any games already released by GSC Game World, you are helping the defenders of Ukraine to protect our Independence. There are 3 days left until the end of the Charity Sale. You are incredible. Do not stop!

notes.title: Российские консольные игроки всё же смогут официально поиграть S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 — по подписке на Xbox Game Pass
notes.content: Российские пользователи консолей Xbox Series X|S смогут поиграть в шутер S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2, несмотря на решение разработчиков не выпускать его полноценно на территории России. В этом им должен помочь подписочный сервис Xbox Game Pass, куда проект попадет с первого дня.

notes.title: Зубы поменять не дадут: GSC Game World подтвердила отсутствие кастомизации главного героя в S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2
notes.content: Согласно информации, опубликованной на официальном Discord-канале, посвященном серии S.T.A.L.K.E.R., в грядущей S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl будет отсутствовать кастомизация персонажа.

notes.title: Ранняя версия трейлера S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 утекла в Сеть
notes.content: В Сеть утекла ранняя версия трейлера игры S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2, который показывали в прошлом году на онлайн-презентации Xbox.

notes.title: "Если будут изменения, мы сообщим": Разработчики S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 о возможном переносе
notes.content: Из-за происходящих на територии Украины событий GSC Game World была вынуждена приостановить разработку S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl, в связи с чем фанаты франшизы стали опасаться еще одного переноса игры.

notes.title: GSC Game World Charity Sale
notes.content:
It has been more than a month since the war started in Ukraine. A painful and horribly long time. But in these exact moments, a genuine unity appears. These days, «Duty» with «Freedom» are standing shoulder to shoulder in a single row with militaries, protecting their motherland. Free volunteers are fetching incredibly rare stuff from the well-developed stashes network. Cossacks from Territorial Defence are consolidating to transform any little town into an impregnable Sich. And mages of the Internet are casting Empire-Annihilation spells to ensure our efficient informational support and helping the world to find the truth about the events. 

And to help these and many other Ukrainians, GSC Game World is starting a charity sale of its games. All the money gained will be transferred to the «Come back alive» fund, which saves Ukrainians' lives each day since 2014. 

The sale is active from the 4th to the 11th of April on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sub/35983/]Steam[/url] (S.T.A.L.K.E.R. trilogy only), GOG, HumbleBundle, Fanatical, Greenmangaming, GamersGate. It includes all the released games of our studio with up to 80% discount.  

While buying during this sale, you are helping to save lives!

And don't forget that you can directly donate to the «Come back alive» fund. More information on the link: [url=https://www.comebackalive.in.ua/donate]comebackalive.in.ua/donate[/url]

notes.title: "Пока не вернемся в РФ": GSC Game World ответила на вопросы об отмене релиза S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 в России
notes.content: Украинская студия GSC Game World ответила на несколько вопросов по ситуации с отменой релиза S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl.

notes.title: Microsoft напомнила о преимуществах Xbox Game Pass после анонса новой подписки PlayStation Plus
notes.content: Корпорация Microsoft напомнила пользователям о преимуществах Xbox Game Pass после появления новости о расширении PlayStation Plus.

notes.title: "Поставок в РФ не будет": М.Видео сообщила об отмене предзаказов на диски S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2
notes.content: Сеть магазинов электронной и бытовой техники "М.Видео" поделилась в сообществе M.Game в социальной сети VK обновленной информацией о ситуации с поставками игровых новинок и предзаказами.

notes.title: Vortex: Разработчики S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 эвакуируются в Чехию
notes.content: Сотрудники студии GSC Game World могут вскоре покинуть территории Украины. Об этом сообщает чешское издание Vortex.

notes.title: "Попытаемся сохранить предзаказы": "М.Видео" прокомментировала отмену релиза S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 в России
notes.content: Торговая сеть "М.Видео" опубликовала сообщение по поводу ситуации с предварительными заказами S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl.

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 не выйдет в России — окончательное решение GSC Game World
notes.content: Студия GSC Game World выпустила заявление по поводу происходящих сейчас событий на территории Украины.

notes.title: Stalker 2 renamed Heart of Chornobyl to reflect Ukrainian spelling
notes.content: Russian forces have invaded Ukraine and the war has now been ongoing for 19 days. Stalker developer GSC Game World is based in the Ukrainian capital city Kyiv, which is currently under attack, and since the beginning of the war has condemned the 'inhuman cruelty' of the invasion and paused development on Stalker 2... Read more.

notes.title: Украинская студия GSC Game World закрыла страницу S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 в российском Steam и сняла все игры с продажи
notes.content: GSC Game World прекратила продажи в Steam на территории России. Разработчики пока не делали заявления по этому поводу, но ни одна игра студии больше не доступна для покупки.

notes.title: GSC Game World подтвердила приостановку разработки шутера S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2
notes.content: GSC Game World подтвердила приостановку разработки S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl. Авторы опубликовали новое видео, в котором рассказали о текущем статусе проекта на фоне разгоревшегося конфликта в Украине.

notes.title: Stalker 2 development paused: 'We are striving to help our employees and their families to survive'
notes.content: Stalker 2 studio GSC Game World was one of the first to speak out against the Russian invasion of Ukraine, and to call for financial aid for the Ukrainian Armed Forces. Today the studio released a brief video emphasizing the increasing danger in the country, which has forced it to move the development of Stalker 2 "to the sidelines" while it focuses on protecting its employees and their families... Read more.

notes.title: Lights! Camera! War…
notes.content:
Ukraine needs all the help it can get.

Fundraising platform of the President of Ukraine — [url=https://u24.gov.ua/]u24.gov.ua[/url]

notes.title: Stalker studio asks for donations to Ukrainian army, laments 'inhuman cruelty' of Russian invasion
notes.content: Following weeks of build-up, Russian forces have invaded Ukraine: there are ongoing reports of explosions and missile strikes against Ukraine's major cities and military infrastructure. Stalker developer GSC Game World is based in the Ukrainian capital city Kyiv, and took to social media to post a message about the conflict... Read more.

notes.title: Russian troops are attacking Ukraine
notes.content:
As of today, the Russian Federation has officially declared war on Ukraine. Our country woke up with the sounds of explosions and weapons fire, but is ready to defend its freedom and independence, for it remains strong and ready for anything. The future is unknown, but we hope for the best, are ever sure of our Armed Forces and our belief in Ukraine.

We thus address all of our colleagues in the gaming industry — players, bloggers or anyone who sees this post in their newsfeed: share this, do not stand aside and help those in need.

Fundraising platform of the President of Ukraine — [url=https://u24.gov.ua/]u24.gov.ua[/url]

Special aid account to support the Armed Forces of Ukraine.
[url=https://bank.gov.ua/ua/news/all/natsionalniy-bank-vidkriv-spetsrahunok-dlya-zboru-koshtiv-na-potrebi-armiyi]UA843000010000000047330992708[/url]
Transfers are possible from all over the globe.

Through pain, death, war, fear and inhuman cruelty, Ukraine will persevere. As it always does.

GSC Game World

notes.title: "Изменения тут не планируются": Разработчики S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 отрицают возможность еще одного переноса игры
notes.content: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of the Chernobyl должна была выйти 28 апреля, но была перенесена. Теперь релиз заявлен на 8 декабря, однако некоторые фанаты опасаются, что игру могут отложить еще раз.

notes.title: "Вам точно понравится!": GSC Game World рассказала о ближайшем показе S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2
notes.content: С момента первой полноценной демонстрации шутера S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl прошло уже восемь месяцев, но когда мы сможем увидеть игру вновь, пока остается лишь догадываться.

notes.title: "С нетерпением жду": Глава Valve Гейб Ньюэлл впервые высказался о S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2
notes.content: У главы Valve Гейба Ньюэлла есть личная рабочая почта, куда могут писать все желающие. Нередко отправителям доходят ответы.

notes.title: Сотни разработчиков занимаются созданием S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl для Xbox Series X|S и ПК
notes.content: Команда разработчиков шутера S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl насчитывает более 500 человек. Соответствующую информацию в комментарии украинскому порталу DOU подтвердил PR-менеджер украинской студии GSC Game World Захар Бочаров.

notes.title: Ремейк первого S.T.A.L.K.E.R., слухи о текучке и разработка Heart of Chernobyl - PR-менеджер GSC Game World отвечает на вопросы
notes.content: PR-менеджер украинской GSC Game World Захар Бочаров дал интервью каналу "Неважно, Кто", в котором ответил на вопросы о студии и серии S.T.A.L.K.E.R., включая готовящийся сиквел. Главное из первой части видео выбрано ниже.

notes.title: Разработчики S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 объяснили отсутствие информации об игре и новых демонстраций
notes.content: Первый геймплей S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl представили в июне прошлого года и вместе с ним сразу открыли предзаказы.

notes.title: "Переговоров с пиратами не ведем": Разработчики S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 готовят план борьбы против взлома игры
notes.content: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 недавно была отложена с апреля на декабрь, и поклонники шутера продолжают заваливать разработчиков различными вопросами.

notes.title: "Нет смысла отвечать на каждый вброс": Представители GSC Game World отреагировали на слухи про выход S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 в 2023 году
notes.content: Представители студии GSC Game World отреагировали на появившиеся сегодня слухи о переносе S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 на 2023 год и проблемную разработку игры. Информацию, напомним, распространил популярный YouTube-канал XGTV.

notes.title: Слух: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 не выйдет на Xbox Series X|S и ПК в декабре 2022 года — игру готовятся снова перенести
notes.content: Перенесенная с апреля на декабрь 2022 года игра S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 от украинской студии GSC Game World может появиться в продаже только в 2023 году. Об этом со ссылкой на свои источники сообщил популярный YouTube-канал XGTV.

notes.title: Разработчики S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Перенос игры не связан с отказом от NFT

notes.title: Stalker 2 has been delayed until the end of 2022
notes.content:
Stalker 2 developer GSC Game World has announced that the hotly-anticipated open-world FPS game will remain in the oven for several months longer. The studio today took to Twitter to explain the decision, citing a need for further development time.

According to the statement on the game's Twitter page, an additional seven months of development are needed "to fulfil our vision and achieve the desired state of the game." With the studio focusing on ensuring the game is as polished as it can be, the Stalker 2 release date has now been pushed back to December 8, 2022.

While players will have to wait that little bit longer before jumping into a post-apocalyptic Chernobyl, GSC Game World has promised that "more information, updates, and showcases" are on the way in the meantime. The last we saw of Stalker 2 was a gameplay trailer back at E3 2021.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Happy New Year, stalkers!
notes.content:
A long time ago, a bunch of pioneers launched S.T.A.L.K.E.R. with an aspiration to create a unique project. And it turned into a trilogy that left a significant trace in the game industry's history. 

Years have passed, and now we are honored to continue S.T.A.L.K.E.R. universe with great passion in our hearts and strong responsibility. The GSC Game World faction is rapidly growing every month, so 2022 we greet as more than 300 people. And with each day, Heart of Chernobyl with all its secrets becomes nearer.

They say that it's vital to wish something for loved ones on the eve of the holidays. Well then, we want to wish you the essential things: solid cossacks health, stalkers gumption, and a whole bag of holiday vibes. Happy new 2022 to you - cossacks, heroes, and stalkers!

Always yours, GSC Game World team.

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl — ARG has come to the end
notes.content:
Friends!

Today is a big day. With pleasure, pride, and little sadness, we want to report that ARG (Alternate Reality Game), which we worked on for so long, is finally come to its end.

A year and a half of work constructing ciphers, audio and video recordings, pages in social networks, and entire sites with a double bottom. Thousands of lines of text and code, scribbled tables in Miro, maps and various parcels, schemes of relationships between multiple characters, and many more things. 

Besides, about characters: we've assumed a certain role for ourselves. We couldn't announce that ARG is our official activity without spoiling the atmosphere of mystery and authenticity. But now, in the end, we can confess and reward the winners. 

The final series of riddles and ciphers led «decoders» to the documents about events in the Zone and unique concept-arts that we want to share with all the stalkers!
https://stalker2.com/argdocs/71uW.rar

But ARG wouldn't be it without a cipher inside of a cipher in the cipher. And the first ones who succeed to the «true ending» are:

1. Kaleb
2. Chiki
3. ha1ber
4. Melomaniac
5. Odnakko

The winners will get S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl Retail Ultimate Edition and some commemorative prizes inside and outside the game. 

This story was created alongside you. We want to express gratitude to all who worried about Veniamin fate, helped SIRCAA or Problesk, worked on both sides, looked for media seeds in our posts, decrypted them, or just watched what was happening from the side.

It was unforgettable!

notes.title: Stalker 2 is getting a multiplayer mode in a free post-launch update
notes.content:
GSC Game World has revealed that its ambitious, open-world first-person shooter Stalker 2 will be getting multiplayer like the original game. This multiplayer mode, which will be free, won't be available at launch though.

The multiplayer mode was mentioned in a now-deleted Twitter post where GSC Game World detailed its future plans for Stalker non-fungible tokens (NFTs) after announcing its first ones yesterday to much criticism. Under the studio's plans, players would have the chance to become the "first-ever metahuman" - a non-player character - or own multiple in-game items.

However, tucked away within the statement, was the confirmation of Stalker 2 multiplayer, which will include gloves and tattoos for players to equip, as well as skins and badges - the latter of which we assume is like an emblem in Call of Duty. The multiplayer will also have both deathmatch and team deathmatch modes (as revealed in PCGamer's latest magazine issue). These items will be available to unlock through multiplayer progression - something we expect to hear more about as we gear up to launch in April 2022.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Happy Halloween!
notes.content:
Too many snorks, bloodsuckers, and other creatures are getting closer to the territories, which people named «safe». Something is on the way, we can feel it. As well as any stalker in the Zone. 

The doors and gates to all the entries are closed. Alarms in the 100 Rads, Wild Territory, Skadovsk, Yanov, and other places warn people to stay inside and not show the faces above decks without emergency necessity. 

Everyone takes a deep breath, enjoys the homely atmosphere, and shares different stories. In a sense, it's even a holiday, and we are happy to congratulate all stalkers. Somewhere out there, outside the Zone, Halloween is being celebrated now. The creatures of the Zone also feel this atmosphere, so they have gone out...

But the true stalkers know that you can find some great stuff for an extremely low price on these exact days! Some vanilla stuff, if you know what we mean.

notes.content: В геймплейном трейлере S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl была показана динамическая перестрелка с противниками, но для любителей действовать без шума и пыли в игре будет предусмотрена возможность скрытного прохождения. Об этом разработчики из украинской студии GSC Game World рассказали в своем официальном Discord-канале.

notes.title: "Бука" ведет переговоры с Valve о выпуске Steam Deck в России
notes.content: Портативная игровая консоль Steam Deck в настоящий момент доступна для предзаказа (бронирования) через магазин Valve в избранном количестве регионов, среди которых США, Япония, Канада и Европа.

notes.title: Retail editions available for pre-order now via selected retailers
notes.content:
Retail editions of S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl are already available for pre-order in Germany, Italy, France and other countries. The list of stores will be updating all the time, so more and more stalkers will have the opportunity to grab habar from the Zone.

If there is still no possibility to pre-order a physical version of the game in your country — don’t worry! We are working on it.

You can find out whether pre-orders are open in your region in a special #pre-order channel of our Discord server. In the nearest future, we will also add all the links to our official website — [url=https://www.stalker2.com]https://www.stalker2.com[/url]

Good hunting!

notes.title: "Принял участие в создании этого шедевра": Раскрыто имя актера озвучки главного героя S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl
notes.content: Главного героя горячо ожидаемого S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl по прозвищу Скиф озвучил известный украинский певец, актер дубляжа и "Голос «95 Квартала»" Денис Любимов. Об этом артист сообщил на своей странице в Instagram. Публикация была размещена 14 июня, однако СМИ обратили на нее внимание лишь сейчас.

notes.title: "Не могу дождаться Starfield": Microsoft выпустила новое музыкальное видео про Xbox Game Pass
notes.content: Бренд Xbox продолжает рекламировать сервис Xbox Game Pass посредством веселых музыкальных клипов. На этот раз рекламный отдел представил видео в стиле 80-х, в котором на фоне забавного видеоряда в песенной форме перечисляются преимущества подписочного сервиса, вроде огромного каталога тайтлов разных жанров, который заставит игроков задуматься, во что поиграть сейчас, а что попробовать позже.

notes.title: STALKER 2 will use Unreal Engine 5
notes.content: Stalker 2 will use Unreal Engine 5 when it releases next year, according to a tweet from developers GSC Game World. It will be among the first crop of releases to use Epic Games' massive engine upgrade, and perhaps the most highly anticipated of them... Read more.

notes.title: GSC Game World раскрыла актуальные продажи серии S.T.A.L.K.E.R.
notes.content: 11 августа компания Koch Media объявила о партнерстве с украинской студей GSC Game World, в рамках которого поможет разработчикам с международным распространением физических копий шутера S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl.

notes.title: GSC Game World перенесла S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 на Unreal Engine 5 и заручилась поддержкой Koch Media
notes.content: Для разработки S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl студия GSC Game World отказалась от древнего X-Ray в пользу Unreal Engine. Игру изначально начали делать еще на четвертой итерации движка, но где-то в процессе постройки проект переехал на пятую. То, что теперь S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2 создается на UE5, сообщили сами разработчики и показали в подтверждение новый скриншот из игры, сделанный в окне новейшего движка.

notes.title: Stalker 2 will be one of the first Unreal Engine 5 games for Xbox Series X|S
notes.content:
Stalker 2 has been touted as one of the first proper next-gen exclusives for Xbox Series X|S. Early glimpses of the game have shown stunning settings and jaw-dropping graphics, something that's truly set it apart from other upcoming releases.

Now we know why Stalker 2 looks as good as it does: it's running on Unreal Engine 5. Announced by GSC Game World on Twitter, the release of Stalker 2 in April 2022, will make it one of the first games running on Epic Games' next-generation engine to release for any platform, as well as Xbox Series X|S.

Given that Stalker 2 will also be launching onto Game Pass and is a three-month timed exclusive for Microsoft's new consoles, we expect the company to make it one of its big showpiece titles for the first half of 2022.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Unreal Engine 5 — is our official choice
notes.content:
We are receiving a lot of questions about the S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl engine version that we are using for development. It's as easy as one-two-three-four-five! Unreal Engine 5 is our official choice.

notes.title: Stalker 2 release date, launch times, gameplay, and latest news
notes.content:
When is the Stalker 2 release date? The long-awaited sequel was first announced during the Xbox and Bethesda Games E3 2021 showcase, with developer GSC Game World also revealing a trailer replete with gameplay and story details. The game's official title is Stalker 2: Heart of Chornobyl, following from Shadow of Chernobyl and Call of Pripyat.

Stalker 2 is an RPG game set in the Chornobyl exclusion zone, where monsters run riot, and humans can be friends and foes alike. You'll have to find a way to survive the dangers lurking in this area while unraveling its mysteries. The scope for Stalker 2 looks enormous, and following our interview with GSC Game World, it's got the potential to be one of the best PC games once it's finally released.

notes.title: Microsoft says it will use cloud streaming to bring 2022 exclusives to Xbox One
notes.content:
Microsoft has said how it plans to keep Xbox One going next year even as developers make use of more powerful hardware: cloud streaming.

In a post on Xbox Wire, Microsoft said some exclusives set for 2022 require the power of the Xbox Series X and S and so will use Xbox Cloud Gaming to run on the eight-year old Xbox One.

Microsoft confirmed it will use Xbox Cloud Gaming to bring Microsoft Flight Simulator, for example, to Xbox One.

notes.title: Stalker 2 system requirements
notes.content:
What are the Stalker 2 system requirements? We're not far away from finally being able to play Stalker 2, and the system requirements suggest that the game is more than accessible for older gaming PCs and laptops.

You won't need the best graphics card to run Stalker 2, but it will certainly help if you're aiming for 4K, 60fps performance. Despite having been announced some time ago, the system requirements haven't changed in the lead-up to release, meaning we're hopeful of a well-optimized experience come launch day.

notes.title: Девочка со сверхспособностями, жуткие существа и разборки группировок в сюжетном трейлере российской игры Pioner
notes.content: Авторы многопользовательского шутера Pioner из российской студии GFA Games в рамках участия в онлайн-презентации PC Gaming Show на E3 2021 показали свежий трейлер своего проекта. В представленном видео продолжительностью почти в четыре минуты разработчики уделили большое внимание сюжетной составляющей, также продемонстрировав немало кадров игрового процесса с перестрелками, взаимодействием с NPC и живыми игроками.

notes.title: Триумф S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: ПК-геймеры массово предзаказывают новую игру от украинской студии GSC Game World
notes.content: Продемонстрированный на презентации Microsoft в рамках выставки E3 2021 геймплейный трейлер долгожданной игры S.T.A.L.K.E.R 2 произвел большое впечатление на геймеров по всему миру. Детище украинской студии быстро взлетело в международный список бестселлеров на площадке Steam, опередив Battlefield 2042, а также уверенно заняло первое место чарта продаж в российском сегменте магазина Valve. Стандартная версия игры доступна отечественным пользователям по цене в 2,499 рублей. Премьера запланирована на 28 апреля 2022 года.

notes.title: Предзаказы, издания и скриншоты S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chernobyl - игра получит два сюжетных DLC и мультиплеер после релиза

notes.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl - Physical Editions

I can almost see the beauty that you are speaking of... The complete set of stalkers' gear: poster, patches, token, backpack for the raids to the Zone, map with safe routes marks and notes, and even the official Zone permit!

They even say that there is an action figure of stalker in special ones. And the most solid catch, the real artifact with a special container for transportation. It's hard to find something like that even for the most versed stalkers, and here it is close at hand.

*Physical edition of  S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl will be available in a few days.
